findings.description: Nit: `select_registry_lane` never consults `policy.default_action`. With the model default `PolicyAction.WAIT`, a registry-driven vendor-limit path always returns `switch` when any eligible alternate lane exists. Legacy `evaluate_policy` still honors WAIT, but the orchestrator now calls only `select_registry_lane`, and roadmap tests force SWITCH, so the default wait posture is silently abandoned.

findings.description: none: Remediations 1–3 and 8 verified: `report_vendor_rate_limit` is granted via `TRUST_DERIVED_OPERATIONS` at elevated trust and is absent from `ADMIN_ACTIONS`; `get_vendor_registry()` and watchdog `vendor_registry` inject `get_audit_service()`; partial missing/ambiguous catalog joins set `cost.known=False` and durable-audit `vendor_catalog_projection_miss`; accepted/duplicate/rejected/compaction audits carry non-secret status/reason fields.

none: Remediations 4–5 verified: `provider_dispatch.dispatch_phase` reports terminal capacity once via best-effort `_report_terminal_capacity` without replacing the result; sync/async CLI and SDK notify only intermediate model-scoped attempts when `has_fallback`; `_collect` owns the single terminal report, including single-model exhaustion.

none: Remediations 6–7 verified: orchestrator accepts `dispatch_agent_id` or provider-carrier `agent_id`, retries the same phase, and injects selected lane as both `dispatch_agent_id` and `agent_id`; provenance uses `capacity_report_status` (`persisted`/`failed`/`skipped`) or `delegated_unconfirmed`/`skipped_ambiguous`, never claims persistence from lane id alone; configured USD ceiling with unknown quote logs `cost_guard unavailable`.

none: GET `/vendors` and GET `/vendors/{agent_id}/availability` match OpenAPI filters/auth (Bearer, X-API-Key, X-Coordinator-API-Key), return typed lane identity (`agent_id`, `vendor_type`, `policy_vendor`, `catalog_vendor`, explicit `location`, capabilities, dispatch_modes), and use RFC7807 problem types for 404/503; no pagination is contracted or required by the vendor-registry spec for the configured roster size.

none: SQL RPCs provide atomic probe upsert, rate-limit insert/identical-replay/conflict, and compaction; tables have no price columns; reads batch one probe, one active-limit, and one catalog query; model-scoped limits leave the lane available while marking only that model unavailable; quotes use Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP to six places per choices.json; registry outage fail-closes unless an explicit agents.yaml fallback is injected, with no hardcoded orchestrator vendor roster.

none: Watchdog first poll persists every lane snapshot with `stale_after = observed_at + 2×interval` and skips transitions; `no_probe_method` maps to unknown; per-lane persist failures are isolated so sibling writes and legacy transition events continue; compaction is scheduled from `run_once`.

none: Finding 12 remains correctly non-actionable: OpenAPI leaves POST 400 unbound to Problem, so `urn:vendor-registry:invalid-observation` is not schema drift under the current contract. No new contract evidence reverses that triage.
